JOIN OUR TEAM

At S & A Group, we believe in dreams and yes, dreams do come true! We are focused on creating leaders in and out of the workplace.  We currently have over 100 agents who are pursuing the life of their dreams.  Here at S&A Group, we understand that to get something you've never had, you have to do some things you've never done, so we are not only committed to your professional development, but personal development as well.  We strive to create a foundation for you that is rooted in integrity, entrepreneurship and legacy building, so that you can build and live the life of your dreams!

COMMITMENT REQUIRED!  Yes, that's right.  We are committed to your success, but for this to work, you must be too!  We are not promising a get rich quick scheme, it requires a recipe of  consistency, hard work and dedication.  As a result, our agents are creating wealth because of those simple components and we'd love for you too as well!  

JOIN NOW

We are a final expense life insurance agency that provides individuals with coverage to help their families in what may be the most difficult time of their lives.  With the average funeral in Mississippi and Alabama costing  thousands (FCGS Funeral Cost Estimate 2012), we assist our clients in securing a cash benefit life insurance policy to help cover the cost of final expenses.
